requirements.evidence: Migrations match the spec: `entities_slug_unique`, softDeletes, cascading FKs, `owner_seq` storedAs plus `entity_memberships_one_owner` (create_entity_memberships_table.php:18-28). Every contract class and method is there: Entity::owner() at Entity.php:47-50, scopes at EntityMembership.php:33-56, UserRole::manageable(), User::membershipFor. The middleware handles the 0/1/>1 dispatch and aborts 403 for non-members (EnsureCurrentEntity.php:24-56). HomeController and pick with Gate::authorize('view') and the audit log are present. CreateEntity has an overridable uniqueSlug and retries on UniqueConstraintViolationException (CreateEntity.php:35-46). The switcher markup uses the required classes and data-current, the navbar link only shows for more than one membership, both lang files are updated and the routes are named. Small gap: when a user belongs to both A and B and the session says A, the dashboard for B renders while TenantContext still holds A.

conventions.evidence: The domain write goes through app/Actions/CreateEntity.php, which authorizes inside. Livewire uses #[Validate] and $this->validate(), policies live in app/Policies, models use #[Fillable], and the persistent middleware is registered (AppServiceProvider.php:44). Docs are updated (database-schema, business-rules, architecture, ops/logging). Deviation: CHANGELOG.md:40 copies the new entry into the already-released `[0.0.0] - 2026-07-07` section as well as [Unreleased].

security.evidence: Every Livewire action is authorized (CreateEntity.php:29 and inside the Action). Dashboard::mount calls authorize('view'), and `#[Locked] public Entity $entity` is covered by a tamper test. pick uses Gate::authorize before writing the session. Role is never client input (hard-coded UserRole::Owner, CreateEntity Action line 28). owner_seq is not fillable, output is escaped with {{ }}, and CSRF tokens are present on the pick forms. Persistent middleware covers Livewire updates.

tests.evidence: Six feature test files. They cover the DB constraints (second owner, including promotion via update), cascades, scopes and factories, policy matrices by role, the 0/1/>1 dispatch for home and the middleware, pick 403 with the session left unchanged, audit log context, slug sequence, a soft-deleted slug, the collision-retry race through an overridden uniqueSlug, bounded retries with rollback, guest/unauthorized calls, the locked-property tamper test, the switcher markup and the navbar condition, and both locales.

simplicity.evidence: The code is mostly lean. Some duplication: the 0/1/>1 dispatch logic appears in both HomeController.php:15-28 and EnsureCurrentEntity.php:43-56, and `create` is authorized twice (CreateEntity.php:29 and Actions/CreateEntity.php:21). TenantContext is a small, justified class the task asks for.

readability.evidence: Names are clear, methods are short, and comments explain the non-obvious points (race retry at CreateEntity.php:33-34, NULL-in-unique-index at the migration lines 20-22, route ordering in web.php). There is no dead code or debug output, and the style matches sibling files (PHPDoc generics on relations).

scope.evidence: Nearly everything serves the task. Small extras: the reserved-slug handling and the stale-session reset are reasonable hardening. Deleting resources/views/home.blade.php follows from the /home change but leaves the `ui.welcome`/`ui.logged_in` lang keys orphaned. The CHANGELOG edit to the released 0.0.0 section is unrelated churn.

issues.explanation: The new-feature entry is duplicated into the already-released [0.0.0] section, which rewrites release history; it belongs only under [Unreleased].
With session entity A, a user who is also a member of B can open /e/B, and the request runs with TenantContext set to A while the page shows B; the tenant context and the routed entity can disagree.
The 0/1/>1 membership dispatch is duplicated almost verbatim in EnsureCurrentEntity.php:43-56 instead of being shared.
`create` is authorized in the component and again inside the Action; one of the two checks is redundant.
`auth()->user()->entities()->count()` runs an extra query on every page render, inside the layout view.
The deleted home view leaves the `ui.welcome`, `ui.logged_in` and related lang keys unused.

review.summary: The change implements the entities data model with a portable one-owner constraint, the policies, a domain Action, the tenant middleware/context, onboarding with collision retry, the switcher, the dashboard and the navbar link, all with thorough tests (including unauthorized and tamper cases) and updated docs. The only problems are minor: a CHANGELOG entry duplicated into a released section, the tenant context not being tied to the routed entity, and some duplicated dispatch logic. Approve with nits.
